questions.text: Mention the social and religious reform measures of Raja Ram Mohan Roy.
questions.text_as_printed: Mention the social and religious reform measures of Raja Ram Mohan Roy. (Medium )

answer.value: Social and religious reform measures of Raja Ram Mohan Roy: He opposed the practice of Sati, the caste system, idol worship, polygamy, child marriage, and all kinds of superstitions. He urged the British government to abolish the meaningless practice of Sati. Raja Ram Mohan Roy, who supported widow remarriage and monotheism, started the process of social reform movement through the newspaper Samvad Kaumudi. Ram Mohan Roy tried to purify Hinduism through rationalism. He advocated English education and ran an English school at his own expense. He also published several periodicals.

questions.text: What was the role of Jyotiba Phule in social reform?
questions.text_as_printed: What was the role of Jyotiba Phule in social reform? (Medium )

answer.value: Role of Jyotiba Phule in social reform: He established the Satyashodhak Samaj to create awareness among the lower classes of Maharashtra. He opened schools for untouchables, orphans, and widows. He condemned Brahminical priesthood and wrote the book Gulamgiri, explaining his thoughts in the form of a dialogue. Along with his wife Savitribai, he started a girls' school in Pune. By opening a rehabilitation center for child widows in 1863 A.D., he tried to end the ongoing cases of infanticide.

questions.text_as_printed: What was the role of Pandit Ramabai in women's reform? (Medium )

answer.value: Role of Pandit Ramabai in women's reform: She was a famous Christian social reformer of India. She received education, going against the social conditions of that time. This institution is still active today, providing livelihood to widows, orphans, and drunkards.

They tried to purify Hinduism through rationalism.

questions.text: What were the measures taken by Sree Narayana Guru for the upliftment of the backward classes?
questions.text_as_printed: What were the measures taken by Sree Narayana Guru for the upliftment of the backward classes? (Average)

answer.value: Measures taken by Sri Narayana Guru to reform backward communities: He established the institution Sri Narayana Dharma Paripalana Yogam (SNDP) in 1903 A.D. He worked for the social and economic progress of backward communities. He opposed the caste system. He opened Sanskrit schools and gave admission to all without discrimination of caste or religion. He expressed the principle of "One God, One Religion, and One Caste." He built more than 30 temples and gave entry to people of all castes.
